### neurobalance
[![Devfolio](https://img.shields.io/badge/Devfolio-View%20Project-4B32C3?style=flat-square&logo=devfolio&logoColor=white)](https://devfolio.co/projects/neurobalance-b087) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source%20Code-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/shagun466/dragonfly-2025) [![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Demo-Live-00C853?style=flat-square&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://dragonfly-2025.netlify.app/) [![Video](https://img.shields.io/badge/Video-Watch-FF0000?style=flat-square&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/yui_Xm39pd0?si=uSs9nBGO416u0tZc) [![Built at](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20at-KodeKalesh%202025-0052CC?style=flat-square)](https://kodekalesh-2025.devfolio.co)

> metal wellbeing

![HTML](https://img.shields.io/badge/HTML-333333?style=flat-square) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-333333?style=flat-square) ![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-333333?style=flat-square) ![Firebase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Firebase-333333?style=flat-square) ![CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/CSS-333333?style=flat-square) ![JavaScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/JavaScript-333333?style=flat-square) ![Flask](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flask-333333?style=flat-square) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-333333?style=flat-square)

**The problem it solves**

Mental-wellbeing services today are broken.
People struggle silently because:

Self-reporting is inaccurate — most apps depend on mood entries that users can lie about or forget to fill.

No continuous monitoring exists — stress builds up over weeks, but apps detect it only when it’s too late.

Clinicians are overworked — long wait times, slow interventions, and lack of regular checkpoints.

No incentive to stay well — mental health apps want engagement, not real improvement.

Workplaces & institutions have no measurable indicators — they want to help, but there is no quantifiable mental wellbeing score to act upon.

As a result, people reach crisis levels without any early detection or support, causing long-term emotional, social, and economic damage.


1. Track Their Stress with Scientific Accuracy

NeuroBalance gives each person a Mental Footprint Index (MFI) — an AI-generated score that reflects their real emotional state based on:

behaviour patterns

mood consistency

lifestyle data

micro-expressions

sensor-backed verification

No more “How are you feeling today?” guesswork.
Users get objective, data-driven insights.

2. Get Early Warnings Before Burnout Happens

The system automatically detects:

rising stress

declining emotional stability

sleep irregularities

pattern shifts

sudden mood drops

And sends early alerts:

“Your stress level is rising. Try a 10-minute guided session.”

Users get help before things get worse.

3. Earn Stress Offset Tokens (SOT) for Staying Mentally Healthy

Users earn blockchain-backed tokens for:

verified meditation

walking

journaling

breathing exercises

emotional consistency

AI-verified improvement

This is the world’s first system where mental wellness = real rewards.

4. Trade Their Wellness Tokens in a Transparent Marketplace

Users can:

Sell tokens

Donate them

Redeem perks

Join corporate wellness programs

Earn badges or NFT achievements

Finally, mental health efforts have a financial + social return.

5. Participate in a DAO (Mental Wellness Governance)

Users can vote on:

new wellness programs

platform features

fund allocation

community initiatives

Voting power is based on positive habits, not money.
This creates a mental-health ecosystem governed by healthy individuals, not wealthy ones.

6. Get Verified Proof of Their Activities

No fake entries.
Every wellness activity is verified using:

AI emotion consistency

sensor data

microexpression checks

voice tone analysis

health app integrations

Aptos blockchain proof

This adds trust, accuracy, and fairness to the system.


7. Improve Workplace/Institutional Wellness

Organizations can use aggregated, anonymized data to:

identify stress hotspots early

offer targeted interventions

measure mental wellness like carbon metrics

reduce burnout, absenteeism, and turnover

NeuroBalance becomes a mental-wellness analytics engine for large groups.

**Challenges we ran into**

1. Verifying User Wellness Activities Without Breaking Privacy

Problem:
We needed a way to confirm that users actually performed stress-reducing activities (meditation, journaling, walking, etc.).
But directly capturing video/audio for verification would violate privacy and increase friction.

Solution:
We used a blend of:

Behavioural pattern matching

Sensor-based cues (step count, phone movement)

AI micro-consistency checks

Timestamp + blockchain proof

This allowed us to verify activities without storing sensitive data.
Result → Fast, private, user-friendly verification.

2. Designing the Mental Footprint Index (MFI)

Problem:
Creating a single wellness score that fairly represents mental health is extremely difficult.
Simple averages failed because:

People have different baselines

Short-term mood dips caused unfair penalties

Fake entries could distort the score

Solution:
We switched to a weighted, time-decayed scoring model, where:

Consistency > one-time entries

Verified actions get higher weight

Recent behaviour is prioritized

AI adjusts the scoring per user baseline

This made MFI reliable and hard to manipulate.

3. Integrating Aptos Blockchain With Real-Time App Data

Problem:
Initially, reward transactions were slow or out of sync with user actions.
Sometimes the token mint happened before the verification, causing incorrect balances.

Solution:
We implemented a two-step pipeline:

Activity verified locally

Reward issued on Aptos only after confirmation

This removed race conditions and made the reward system consistent.

4. Building a Fair DAO Voting System Without Token Bias

Problem:
Traditional DAOs give influence to the richest users.
But our wellness platform needed voting power based on healthy behaviour, not wealth.

Solution:
We built a custom participation-score-based governance model, where voting power is earned through:

Verified activities

Consistency

Engagement

This ensures the most mentally active & positive users shape the platform.

5. Stress Testing the Dashboard UI/UX

Problem:
The dashboard felt cluttered when displaying:

MFI score

Alerts

Activity logs

Token rewards

DAO votes

Marketplace

Too much data → confusing experience.

Solution:
We redesigned the panel using:

Card-based layout

Progressive disclosure

Minimalist component hierarchy

Now users see important data first, and details only when they want them.

6. Random Frontend Bugs

A few examples:

React state not syncing with live updates

Firebase authentication loop

Carousel animation interfering with scroll effects

DAO vote modal freezing on mobile

Fixes:

Rewriting state logic with context

Adding debounced listeners

Using CSS isolation for animations

Refactoring modal into a portal

Each bug taught us something about scaling UI/UX properly.

**APTOS BLOCKCHAIN**

1. Aptos = Transparent, Tamper-Proof Proof of Wellness

Every time a user completes a verified mental-wellness activity (like meditation, journaling, walking, breathing exercises):

Our AI verifies the activity

A small “Proof of Action” record is stored on Aptos

This creates a tamper-proof wellness ledger

Why this matters:

No user can fake progress

Institutions (colleges/companies) can trust wellness data

Bias-free tracking because entries cannot be changed or deleted

This becomes the world’s first Mental Wellness Blockchain Ledger.

2. Aptos Tokens = Incentives for Healthy Behaviour

We issue Aptos-based reward tokens every time the user completes a verified activity.

These tokens can be used to:

Unlock premium AI insights

Participate in DAO decisions

Redeem discounts from partnered wellness brands

Donate to mental-health NGOs

Why blockchain?

Centralized reward systems can be:

Cheated

Manipulated

Reset by the platform

But Aptos-based tokens are:

Verifiable

Scarce

Owned by the user

This creates a healthy-behaviour economy

3. DAO Governance = Community-Driven Mental Health Decisions

Using Aptos smart contracts, we built a DAO controlled by users, where voting power comes from participation—not money.

Voting power = participation score (based on verified activities)

Users vote on:

New wellness features

Activity categories

Allocation of community wellness funds

New challenges or goals

Why this is revolutionary:

No wealth influence

No admin manipulation

Community decides the platform’s direction

4. Immutable Stress & Wellness Trends for Institutions

Organizations like:

Universities

Workplaces

Wellness programs

…often rely on manual or fake self-reports.

Using Aptos:

Aggregated wellness trends become immutable

Zero personal identity stored

Institutions get trustworthy insights without invading privacy

This allows:

Early detection of campus burnout

Better HR mental-health strategies

Company-wide wellness improvements

This solves a real-world problem.

5. Blockchain for Privacy Without Sacrificing Accountability

All personal data stays off-chain.

Only hashed activity proofs go on Aptos.

This creates:

Accountability (data cannot be altered)

Privacy (no identity exposure)

We achieve a rare combo:
Private + Verified
Anonymous + Accountable

Traditional systems cannot offer this balance.

6. Marketplace & Skill Exchange = Tokenized Well-Being Economy

Users can spend tokens on:

1-on-1 wellness mentor sessions

Self-care items

Yoga instructors

Meditation experts

Every transaction is secured by Aptos smart contracts.

7. Why Aptos Specifically?

We chose Aptos because of:

✔ High transaction speed

Perfect for real-time activity verification + token rewards

✔ Low transaction fees

Crucial when users earn frequent micro-rewards

✔ Move programming language

More secure + safer than Solidity

✔ Hackathon-friendly ecosystem

Grants, APIs, and fantastic documentation

Aptos turns our mental-health platform into a trustless, reward-powered, community-driven ecosystem, where positive behaviour is verified, recorded, and incentivized—with complete privacy.
